The design

A · Shell + base plate, flush knobs

Round 3: nothing protrudes but the feet. One folded shell (top + 4 walls) and one base plate. The plate carries the Pi stack and holds both encoders on fold-up tabs 11.5 behind the faces, so the 39 x 5 caps sit flush in Ø40 openings. Rear sockets sit 1 mm inside the wall; plugs reach in. The plate lifts in from below and takes 2 screws from underneath; the screen is taped in.

Mechanism
plate with Pi, DAC and encoders lifts into the shell from below; 2 screws from underneath; caps pushed on last
Layout
Pi flat, USB-C side at the rear, USB/Ethernet flush behind the left wall; front encoder right of the Pi; side encoder beside the SD end
Load path
knobs -> plate tabs -> plate -> feet -> shelf
Process
laser-cut flat, 6 + 2 hand folds on perforated lines (UNTESTED recipe)

Flat pattern: Shell (top + 4 walls)

6 folds by hand, 5052-H32_1.0. Untested folds: no coupon has held for this recipe yet.

Flat pattern: Base plate with encoder tabs

2 folds by hand, 5052-H32_1.0. Untested folds: no coupon has held for this recipe yet.
